text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Sakura Laurel was victorious in the 
Nakayama Kimpai. Her legs felt no pain, 
nor did they feel hot. She was able to 
kick off the turf with all her might and 
race through.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
With a smile blooming like cherry 
blossoms, Sakura Laurel expresses her 
gratitude to the Trainer who never gave up 
and walked alongside her.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Where should we aim for the next race? It 
seems Narita Brian will run in the Hanshin 
Daishoten before taking on the Tenno Sho 
(Spring).

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
If she's going to face Narita Brian, it 
should be in a GⅠ showdown. Sakura Laurel 
sets her sights on the Tenno Sho (Spring) 
instead of the Hanshin Daishoten.
